entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, I found some great intel.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: This time it's bullying by a[n]Kosei student they call a queen.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: She's been ordering around a male[n]student who goes by the name M.[n]Kinda like the M in S&M...
I wish I was in his shoes.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It makes you want to[n]cry, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The girl acting like a[n]queen is Hikari Shimizu.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I wonder if it's more likely[n]that a girl will turn out like[n]that if she has S as an initial...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Well, I already posted the[n]warning, so you should take[n]it on when you have the time!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hopefully you don't end up an M!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What did he mean by S and M? Those[n]are shirt sizes, right? Is it the size of[n]clothes?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, it seems like she's a worthy[n]target. Let's find time to consult the[n]others at the hideout.
I've obtained intel on a target.[n]Perhaps I should see what everyone[n]has to say at the hideout...
